description: This file is a code-behind for the ShowAns.aspx page, handling display and submission of student exam answers, interacting with SQL Server database to retrieve and update answer data.

classes.name: ShowAns
classes.description: Partial class for the ShowAns ASP.NET Web Form page, managing answer display and submission.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; retrieves student answers from database and populates UI controls based on session variables.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the Admin Panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the Admin Queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates total marks, updates the database with student's answers, deletes student from course queue, and redirects to course queue page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the login page, logging out the user.
